# EmeraldCast

> EmeraldCast is a free, browser-based multi-stream viewer for Twitch. It lets you watch
> several Twitch streams at the same time in one page, with no account or installation
> required.

## What it does

- Watch multiple Twitch streams side by side in an adjustable grid
- Switch between a grid layout and a main-stream-with-sidebar layout (resizable)
- Drag and drop streams to reorder them
- Choose which stream plays audio; all others stay muted
- Pin any stream's chat in a side panel
- Connect a Twitch account (optional) to see followed channels and their live status
- Share a set of streams via URL, e.g. https://emeraldcast.vercel.app/?streams=channel1,channel2

## Links

- App: https://emeraldcast.vercel.app/
- Source code: https://github.com/Zeikrom251/EmeraldCast
